description: The plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three different models. The x-axis is labeled “Cost” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled “Reliability Score” with a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with tick labels at intervals of 10. A blue line, representing the “3-Model Ensemble”, begins at approximately (0, 87) and declines to approximately (10, 73) with a generally steady trend. A red line, representing the “2-Model Ensemble”, begins at approximately (0, 83) and declines to approximately (10, 71), with a plateau between x-values of 2 and 6 where the score remains at approximately 75. An orange line, representing “GPT-4”, begins at approximately (0, 80) and declines to approximately (10, 35) with a generally steady decline.
